sections.capsule: Our promise is honesty over hype. Health pages carry citations, and each page states honestly whether a physician has reviewed it yet.
sections.body:
Health content is reviewed by physicians of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group. Each holds a BAMS:

- **Dr. Deepu John, BAMS** — Chief Physician & Head of Department
- **Dr. Akhila Oommen, BAMS** — Ayurvedic Physician

A page one of them has approved carries their name and the date; a page that has not been reviewed yet says so at the top. Write to us at info@kairali.com or on WhatsApp at +91 92898 38797.
